description:
Nine CarSim runs exported from the high-fidelity vehicle-dynamics model used to build the simulation pre-training dataset of the manuscript, sampled at 100 Hz with 580 channels per run.

  • data/carsim_sim_runs_121-123.zip — runs 121, 122, 123 (95–105 s each, road friction μ = 0.50)
  • data/carsim_sim_runs_124-126.zip — runs 124, 125, 126 (95–110 s each, μ = 0.50 / 0.70)
  • data/carsim_sim_runs_127-129.zip — runs 127, 128, 129 (100–110 s each, μ = 0.70)

Channels include body velocities and accelerations, yaw rate, steering-wheel angle, per-wheel lateral forces, slip angles, vertical loads and tire–road friction coefficients. All runs start from rest and cover the linear tire region as well as nonlinear saturation. Units follow the CarSim display export: km/h for velocities, g for accelerations, deg for angles, N and N·m for forces and moments.
notes: Data accompanying the manuscript "Vehicle Lateral Velocity Estimation System Embedding Time-Varying Cornering Stiffness Learning Considering Sim-to-Real Gap". Released under CC BY 4.0.
